title: Bridge and Screens
subtitle: Panels that look busy
text:
Control panels come in Navigation, Engineering and Reactor versions; cut one from another on a stonecutter. Wall screens show a star map or the ship status. The Holo Table shows a slowly turning hologram.

The Jump Countdown Display counts down from 30 seconds when it gets a redstone signal, beeps near the end, and gives out a redstone pulse at zero. /simplemachines countdown sets any time.

Story Log Terminals hold a written log. Use a book and quill or a written book on one to copy its text in, and use it with an empty hand to read the log in chat. /simplemachines log can write and lock a log.
